advice.replySubject: Lakeshore Dental Group workers compensation: items needed before quoting
advice.replyBody:
Hi Marguerite,

Thank you for sending the workers compensation submission for Lakeshore Dental Group, effective Dec 1, 2026. Before we can put a quote together, could you help with the following:

1. Claim count: the application shows 3 claims and your email says three, all closed, but the Quillhaven Mutual loss run shows 4 claims with one still open. Please confirm the correct count.
2. Open claim: a status update on the hygienist shoulder strain from Jun 2, 2025, which shows $6,500 reserved.
3. A signed and dated application; the applicant statement is blank.
4. The drug-free workplace question on the application, which is unanswered.
5. Estimated headcount, payroll and job split for the Lincoln Park office opening January 2027.

If we can have these soon, it will help us work toward your Oct 20, 2026 deadline.

Thanks,
Demo User
Antsurance

issues.title: Claim count disagrees
issues.detail: The application lists 3 claims in three years and the broker's email says three claims, all closed. The Quillhaven Mutual loss run valued Sep 30, 2026 lists 4 claims, $33,150 incurred, one open. Four or more would refer the quote to an underwriter.
issues.ask: Confirm the correct claim count for the past three years and correct the application if needed.

issues.title: Open shoulder strain claim
issues.detail: The loss run shows a hygienist shoulder strain from Jun 2, 2025 still open with lost time, $14,300 paid and $6,500 reserved, while the broker's email says all claims are closed.
issues.ask: Provide a current status and outlook on the open hygienist shoulder strain claim.

issues.title: Application unsigned
issues.detail: The application's applicant statement is not signed, and the name, title and date are blank.
issues.ask: Send a signed and dated application.

issues.title: Drug-free workplace unanswered
issues.detail: The application has neither Yes nor No checked for drug-free workplace, and no other document answers it.
issues.ask: Confirm whether there is a drug-free workplace program.

issues.title: Fourth office opening Jan 2027
issues.detail: The broker's email says a Lincoln Park office opens January 2027 adding about six people, whose payroll is not in the $1,530,000 on the application.
issues.ask: Provide estimated headcount, payroll and class split for the Lincoln Park office.

issues.title: Employee count differs
issues.detail: Antsurance holds 22 employees; the application gives 24 (20 full time, 4 part time).

issues.title: No return-to-work program
issues.detail: The application answers No to a return-to-work program, alongside a lost time claim still open on the loss run.

issues.title: Premium target and payroll growth
issues.detail: The broker's email asks for a quote at or under the expiring $31,400. The loss run shows payroll rising from $1,402,000 to $1,468,000 to $1,530,000, and the current year is valued only through Sep 30, 2026.

advice.headline: Workers compensation cross-sell for Lakeshore Dental Group; not ready to quote until claims count, signature and drug-free answer are resolved.
